name: MCP Airlock
description: Enables secure, zero-trust access to MCP tools through short-lived, signed capability leases that bind tool execution to specific sessions, intents, and constraints. Prevents prompt injection attacks and privilege escalation with dynamic risk scoring, policy enforcement, and tamper-evident audit logging.
